用铅笔在纸上画一个形状。
shaped: The kite is shaped like a bird.
这只风筝做得像一只鸟。
What is this bread shaped like?
这个面包做成什么形状啦？
The cookie is shaped like a bunny!
这块饼干的形状像一只小兔子！
share: Please share your cookies with your friends.
请和朋友们分享你的饼干。
Will you share your toys with me?
你愿意和我一起玩你的玩具吗？
It is nice to share your umbrella.
分享你的雨伞真是件好事。
shark: The big shark swims in the blue ocean.
大鲨鱼在蓝色的海洋里游泳。
Does a shark live in the ocean?
The shark in the movie looks so big!
电影里的鲨鱼看起来好大呀！
sharp: My new pencil is very sharp.
Why is the eagle's beak so sharp?
老鹰的嘴为什么这么尖呀？
Look out for the sharp rocks in the water!
shave: My father shaves at the sink.
你爸爸什么时候刮胡子呀？
Wow, my father shaves very fast!
哇，我爸爸刮胡子刮得好快！
she: She goes to the park on her bike.
shed: The rake is in the garden shed.
耙子放在花园的小棚屋里。
Who left the shed door open?
Look inside the little red shed!
看看那个红色小棚屋的里面！
sheep: The sheep eat grass in the green field.
绵羊在绿绿的田野里吃草。
Where do the sheep sleep at night?
Look at the sheep running on the green grass!
sheet: Put a clean sheet on the bed.
在床上铺一条干净的床单。
Is this sheet for the big bed?
这条床单是铺大床的吗？
The cold sheet feels so nice in summer!
夏天凉凉的床单摸起来真舒服！
shelf: Put the toys on the shelf, please.
What is on the high shelf?
高高的架子上放着什么呀？
Oh no, the book slides off the shelf!
哎呀，书从架子上滑下来啦！
shell: I have a pink shell from the beach.
我有一枚在海滩捡的粉色贝壳。
Can you hear the ocean in the shell?
你能听到贝壳里的大海声吗？
Look at the little crab in the shell!
看贝壳里的那只小螃蟹！
shelter: The tent is a good shelter from the rain.
Where do birds find shelter in the winter?
冬天鸟儿们去哪里安身呢？
The big tree gives cool shelter to the deer!
大树给小鹿送来一片阴凉！
shine: The moon and the sun shine in the sky.
月亮和太阳在天上发光。
Does the sun shine in the winter?
冬天的太阳也会照耀大地吗？
Clean the window so the sun can shine in.
把窗户擦干净，让阳光照进来。
shiny: The shiny red apple is for you.
这个红亮亮的苹果是给你的。
Do you like my shiny new shoes?
你喜欢我闪亮亮的新鞋子吗？
What a shiny goldfish you have!
ship: The big ship is on the blue ocean.
大轮船在蓝色的海洋上。
Where will the ship go tomorrow?
这艘船明天要开去哪里呀？
Look at the big ship on the water!
shirt: My new shirt has a dinosaur on it.
我的新衬衫上有一只恐龙。
Is your shirt too small now?
你的衬衫现在是不是太小啦？
What a colorful shirt you have!
shoe: My left shoe is under the bed.
我左脚的鞋子在床底下。
你另一只鞋子在哪里呀？
Oh no, mud is all over my new shoe!
哎呀，泥巴弄得我新鞋上到处都是！
shoo: The farmer says shoo to the crows.
农夫对乌鸦喊着嘘嘘，把它们赶跑。
Shoo the cat off the table, please.
Why did you shoo the crow from the garden?
你为什么把乌鸦从花园里赶走呀？
shoot: I shoot the ball into the basket.
Can you shoot the ball from there?
